description:
SUMMARY
Stylish studio in sought-after Century Wharf, walking distance to Cardiff Bay and city centre. Spacious layout with modern kitchen/lounge, river views, separate-feel bedroom, built-in storage, plus gym, pool & 24hr concierge. Ideal city living.

DESCRIPTION
Situated within the ever-popular Century Wharf development, this stunning studio apartment offers the perfect blend of modern living and convenience; just a short walk from Cardiff Bay and the City Centre, with excellent transport links via the M4, A4232, and local public transport.

From the moment you step inside, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall complete with additional storage, ideal for keeping the space clutter-free. To the left, a sleek and contemporary bathroom offers a stylish finish. The main living area is truly impressive, featuring a large open-plan kitchen/lounge with a modern fitted kitchen and expansive windows that flood the room with natural light, while providing beautiful river views.

The cleverly designed layout creates a unique sense of separation, with the bedroom area subtly set apart from the main living space, offering a private and cosy retreat, complete with built-in wardrobes for added convenience. Residents of Century Wharf also benefit from exclusive on-site leisure facilities, including a gym, swimming pool, and the reassurance of a 24-hour concierge service—perfect for a secure and lifestyle-focused living experience.
